text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Aston Machan—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ah, there are Paka Petits here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of Aston Machan's gaze
was a crane game filled with plushies
themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"They are rivals to the Mar-chan Doll, after all.
Mar-chan wanted to investigate what makes them so popular."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The texture, the cushioning, the stitch strength...
There are so many things I want to inspect.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan goods don't end
just by being delivered. Mar-chan wants to bring
the greatest happiness to everyone who picks them up."
choice_data_list: In that case, I'll get it for the sake of research.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Then I shall cheer with the Chan-doll.
Hip, hip, hooray.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
